name: Pixel Art
author: example
description: Redraw stills as pixel art from scratch, with a palette setting and Aseprite as the human-owned editor.

nodes.need: redraw each still as pixel art from scratch
nodes.skill: **Do:** for each still in `assets/inserts/`, draw it again as pixel art from scratch (no filter over the original) at the size and palette set in Settings ▸ Pixel Art. Save to `assets/inserts/<ID>-<beat>-pixel.png` and list them in `assets/inserts/<ID>-pixel.md`.

nodes.need: touch up the pixel art in Aseprite
nodes.skill: **Human does:** opens each `-pixel.png` in Aseprite (Connections ▸ Aseprite), fixes stray pixels, saves over it, then marks done in Ventosa ▸ to-do.

connections.name: Aseprite
connections.what: pixel-art editor used by the touch-up node
